mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_keys (key_hash, models, spend, max_budget, rpm_limit, tpm_limit, expires_at, blocked, metadata, created_at) VALUES (#{keyHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{models,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB), #{spend,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{maxBudget,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{rpmLimit,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{tpmLimit,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{blocked,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, CAST(#{metadata,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB), #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT id, key_hash, CAST(models AS VARCHAR) AS models, spend, max_budget, rpm_limit, tpm_limit, expires_at, blocked, CAST(metadata AS VARCHAR) AS metadata, created_at FROM api_keys WHERE key_hash = #{keyHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
